JarvisCloudMission.title: JarvisCloudMission
JarvisCloudMission.description: Stores a voice command mission, multi-AI council synthesis, and executed phone action in Firestore.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this mission.

prompt.description: The Uzbek voice or text command issued by the user.

mode.description: Execution mode of the AI Council.

finalSpeech.description: Final synthesized Uzbek voice response from JARVIS-CORE.

executedDeviceAction.description: Optional summary of the hardware/system action executed on the phone.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the mission was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the mission was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AutoCallReplyLog.title: AutoCallReplyLog
AutoCallReplyLog.description: Stores an incoming phone call screened and automatically answered by the Astrafolio AI Secretary.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user.

callerNumber.description: Phone number or identifier of the incoming caller.

callerLabel.description: Display label or context of the caller.

statusPreset.description: Active user availability mode (e.g., Uchrashuvdaman, Rulda, Bandman).

aiGeneratedReply.description: Uzbek automatic response spoken via TTS and prepared for SMS reply.

autoAnswered.description: Whether the AI secretary automatically screened and responded to the call.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the call was logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the call log was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VoiceNoteItem.title: VoiceNoteItem
VoiceNoteItem.description: Stores a voice-dictated note or task created through Uzbek voice commands.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user.

title.description: Short title of the voice note.

content.description: Full text content of the voice note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the voice note was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the voice note was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/missions/{missionId}.description: User-scoped cloud archive of voice commands, AI Council reports, and phone control actions.

/users/{userId}/call_logs/{callId}.description: User-scoped log of incoming calls handled by the AI Auto-Responder Secretary.

/users/{userId}/voice_notes/{noteId}.description: User-scoped voice notes dictated via hands-free commands.
